messages:
Taylor Reed: Hi team, starting my first week today! Quick payroll/benefits questions: 1) My relocation stipend showed as 'pending' on the portal— is that separate from payroll? 2) My benefits portal says 'waiting for HR approval' after I uploaded docs. Does that block the health plan effective date or just some perks? 3) Who do I ping about the company card activation?

Nina Gomez: Welcome Taylor :wave: Relocation is handled as a one-time taxable payroll item and goes through Payroll, not the expense card. If it's pending it usually means payroll is waiting on the relocation approval form from People Ops. For benefits: if it says 'waiting for HR approval' that can delay plan effective date; we usually finalize approvals within 3 business days after document verification. Card activation is handled in Spend; try the in-app activate flow first. If it still shows pending, DM me.

Payroll Bot: Note: Relocation payments are processed on the next payroll run after approvals. Payroll runs every other Friday; deposits land T+2 business days. Example paystub line: RELOC-ONC 03/01 $2,500.00 (taxable).

Eric Liu: If benefits approval is pending because of missing dependent verification, that can delay dependent coverage but not your core employee-only coverage. If you uploaded proof that looks blurry, HR will request a clearer scan. Also if you need retro start date changes we need the paperwork signed by your manager and HR.

Taylor Reed: Thanks, that helps. Where can I check the approval status? The benefits portal is a bit opaque.

Nina Gomez: Use the benefits portal -> Documents -> Status. If it shows 'Under Review' that's us. You can also email benefits@redwood.com and include the document name and your employee ID. We'll reply within 1 business day.

HR Bot: Reminder: New hire benefits window = 30 days from start date. Relocation onboarding checklist: https://intra.redwood.com/onboarding/relocation-checklist

Taylor Reed: Appreciate it. I'll DM a screenshot of the card state if it doesn't activate. Also looping in my manager to confirm the relocation form signature. Thanks everyone :pray:
